title: Task estimated minutes with per-column rollup
findings: MCP update_task was a second read-merge-full-PUT caller and would have NULLed the new field on every edit; fixed. Enumeration gap, not design gap.
.husky/pre-commit runs `biome ci . && pnpm run build` which does NOT typecheck; a non-compiling commit passes it (pre-existing).
`pnpm --filter <pkg> test -- <path>` silently runs the whole suite; the `--` is consumed. Use no `--`.
Unformatted reference code in a design doc propagates verbatim into codegen output.
.sdlc/ is not gitignored and biome lints it, so `biome ci .` exits 1 and the pre-commit hook blocks committing run artifacts.
cost_caveat: Premium tier materially understated: senior-reviewer and security-reviewer emitted no cost events at all; orchestrator overhead unbilled; opus estimated vs flash vendor-reported; Gemini 3.7 rates still TODO(pricing). Input amplification is evidenced; the tier ratio is not.
